about.body: Angabin Teb is an Iranian health platform bringing medical services, nutrition and health knowledge together in one place. Our goal is to provide easy and trustworthy access to health care for everyone.

contact.body: To reach the Angabin Teb team, you can contact us through the site's support section, email or social media. We respond to your messages as quickly as possible.

ambulance.title: Ambulance
ambulance.body: Scheduled, non-emergency medical transport. Book a time and city in advance like any other service. This is not an emergency response service and no live arrival estimate is provided. For emergencies, call your local emergency number.
